working_definition: Olfactory projection neurons of type VA1d (Li et al. 2017), 48 h / 72 h APF or adult (pharate adult and adult).

best_match.fbbt_term: adult antennal lobe projection neuron VA1d adPN
best_match.fbbt_definition: Yu et al. (2010) find 4 per hemisphere. Adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron from the ad neuroblast lineage with dendrites that mainly innervate antennal lobe glomerulus VA1d. This is the seventh cell type to be generated post-embryonically by neuroblast ALad1 (Yu et al., 2010) and its axon innervates the anterior/ventral region of the lateral horn (Marin et al., 2002, Tanaka et al., 2004). There are around two of these per hemisphere, they fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract and they are cholinergic (Bates et al., 2020).

justification: Mz19+/acj6+ VA1d PNs are anterodorsal (adPN) VA1d projection neurons. Mature term from the pharate adult stage (curator).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00067357 adult antennal lobe projection neuron VA1d adPN (exact match).
